moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals, two of the UK's biggest music events, begin this Thursday and run through the Bank Holiday weekend, featuring headliners like Fontaines D.C., Charli XCX, Skepta, Chase & Status, Florence + The Machine, Dave, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Lineup Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds incoming! Who are you most hyped to see this Bank Holiday weekend? Fontaines D.C., Charli XCX, Skepta, Florence + The Machine, Dave, Raye – what a lineup.

angles.name: Festival Weekend Prep
angles.copy: Tent packed? Wellies ready? Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off tomorrow for a massive Bank Holiday weekend of music. Let's do this!

moments.title: Creamfields & All Points East continue
moments.blurb: Electronic music giant Creamfields returns to Cheshire this weekend (Aug 27-29) alongside London's All Points East, which wraps up on Sunday (Aug 30), both drawing huge crowds for the final big festivals of summer.

angles.name: Dance Festival Weekend
angles.copy: Creamfields and All Points East are bringing the beats this Bank Holiday weekend! Who's heading to Cheshire or Victoria Park for one last summer dance?

angles.name: End of Summer Festival Vibe
angles.copy: The summer festival season is winding down with Creamfields and All Points East. Make the most of it!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 27, 2026, making it the longest-running British Number 1 of all time.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at the top! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong at UK Number 1. A true chart phenomenon.

angles.name: Shakira & Burna Boy at #2
angles.copy: Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at Number 2 on the Official Singles Chart, following its World Cup final performance.

moments.title: Valerie Simpson turns 80
moments.blurb: Valerie Simpson, one half of the iconic Motown songwriting and performing duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 80th birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson! From 'Ain't No Mountain High Enough' to 'Solid,' her influence on soul and R&B is immense.

angles.name: Soulful Songwriter
angles.copy: Celebrating Valerie Simpson's 80th today! A true songwriting genius who gave us so many timeless hits with Nickolas Ashford.

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 60
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish lead singer of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the one and only Shirley Manson! The fierce frontwoman of Garbage, still pushing boundaries.

angles.name: Scottish Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Scottish rock legend Shirley Manson's 60th today. What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Keke Palmer turns 33
moments.blurb: American actress, singer, and TV personality Keke Palmer, known for roles in 'Akeelah and the Bee' and 'Nope,' celebrates her 33rd birthday.

angles.name: Keke Palmer Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the multi-talented Keke Palmer! Actress, singer, presenter – is there anything she can't do?

moments.title: Alex Lifeson turns 73
moments.blurb: Alex Lifeson, the legendary guitarist and co-founder of Canadian progressive rock band Rush, celebrates his 73rd birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Rush Guitar God Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Alex Lifeson of Rush turns 73! What an absolute guitar legend. What's your favourite Rush riff?

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Sending early birthday wishes to Rush's Alex Lifeson, celebrating 73 years of prog-rock mastery tomorrow.

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating lead singer of Florence + The Machine, will celebrate her 40th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Florence + Machine turns 40
angles.copy: Can you believe Florence Welch will be 40 on Friday? Still bringing that incredible energy and voice to Florence + The Machine!

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout Florence
angles.copy: Early birthday shoutout to the mesmerising Florence Welch, celebrating her 40th this Friday. What’s your go-to Florence + The Machine anthem?

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Country pop superstar Shania Twain, known for hits like 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much,' celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Shania Twain Birthday
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Shania Twain turns 61 this Friday. The Queen of Country Pop, still impressing us much.

angles.name: Iconic Shania
angles.copy: The one and only Shania Twain celebrates her 61st on Friday! What's your favourite Shania anthem to sing along to?

moments.title: Jack Black turns 57
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and musician Jack Black, known for Tenacious D and his many film roles, celebrates his 57th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Jack Black Birthday
angles.copy: It's Jack Black's 57th birthday on Friday! From Tenacious D to School of Rock, he's a true rock 'n' roll icon.

angles.name: Rock & Comedy King
angles.copy: Happy early birthday to the legend that is Jack Black, turning 57 this Friday! What's your favourite Jack Black moment?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Monday
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, providing a long weekend to mark the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Weekend
angles.copy: Long weekend incoming! Monday is the Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales & Northern Ireland. How are you spending your last blast of summer?

angles.name: End of Summer Plans
angles.copy: It's the unofficial end of summer this Bank Holiday Monday. Time for one last BBQ or a trip to the coast?

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Weekend
moments.blurb: London's vibrant Notting Hill Carnival typically takes over the streets of West London during the Summer Bank Holiday weekend, celebrating Caribbean culture with music, parades, and food.

angles.name: Carnival Vibes
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest street party in Europe! Notting Hill Carnival is set to bring vibrant energy to London this Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: London Bank Holiday
angles.copy: Notting Hill Carnival is the place to be this Bank Holiday weekend if you're in London. Expect incredible music, food, and culture.

moments.title: Back to school for England & Wales
moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales are generally set to reopen for the new academic year on Tuesday, September 1st, marking the end of the summer holidays.

angles.name: School's Out... Almost
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for many as kids across England and Wales head back to school on Tuesday! Wishing all pupils and teachers a great new term.

angles.name: September School Run
angles.copy: Get ready for the morning rush! School gates reopen on September 1st for students in England and Wales. How was your summer break?

moments.title: Ryan Ross turns 40
moments.blurb: Ryan Ross, former guitarist and lyricist for Panic! At The Disco and The Young Veins, celebrates his 40th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Panic! At The Disco Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to Ryan Ross this Sunday! The creative force behind some of Panic! At The Disco's most iconic early tracks.

angles.name: Emo Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating Ryan Ross's 40th this Sunday. Which Panic! At The Disco song written by Ryan is your all-time favourite?

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, known for his distinctive voice and hits like 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance,' celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday. [cite: 51 (checked 1945 for birth year)]

angles.name: Van The Man Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incomparable Van Morrison this Monday! A true musical icon from Northern Ireland.

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring talent of Van Morrison, who turns 81 on Bank Holiday Monday. What's your favourite song from 'Van the Man'?
